none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

results.references: - Mikhail Rudomanov, Ivan Fomin, Alexander V. Gasnikov, Fedor S. Stonyakin. [Descending Everest, Part I: Oracle Complexity of Convex Optimization under $(L_0,L_1)$-Smoothness](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.21461v2). 2026 (October preprint; November v2 used). Complexity: $1+N=\Omega(1+\sqrt{L_0R^2/\varepsilon}+L_1R/\sqrt{\log(2+L_1R)})$ exact value-and-gradient oracle calls for arbitrary deterministic methods achieving $f(\hat x)-f^\star\le\varepsilon$, with $L_0,L_1,R>0$, $\varepsilon\le L_0R^2$, and worst-case dimension allowed to grow.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a convex real-valued function on Euclidean space. A global minimizer xstar exists with ‖x0 − xstar‖ ≤ R.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: spec.Instance and spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, ConvexOn and minimizer clauses.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: One oracle returns precisely ∇f(x) at any queried point. Gradient uniqueness makes replies independent of history and oracle seed. No function values are supplied. Algorithms may randomize and make unrestricted adaptive queries; budgets count individual gradient calls.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, HasGradientAt clause; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: spec.Query and spec.Reply; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm, Setup.allowedAlgorithm, executeWithTrace and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient map is differentiable everywhere and satisfies ‖D(∇f)(x)‖ ≤ L0 + L1‖∇f(x)‖ globally. L0 > 0 and L1 ≥ 0; continuity of the Hessian is not explicitly required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible, Differentiable and fderiv clauses; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is ℝ^d with its Euclidean norm, where d ≥ ⌈17592186044416·(1 + L1R + √(L0R²/ε))^5⌉.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters d, L0, L1, x0, R and ε are public. R > 0 and 0 < ε ≤ L0R²/16. A radius bound is supplied, without an additional bound on the initial objective gap or gradient norm.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput and spec.valid; LongTails/Setups/RadiusOnlyGeneralizedSmoothConvex.lean: spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a point xhat with integrable objective gap satisfying E[f(xhat) − f(xstar)] ≤ ε for some global minimizer xstar. The output need not be a queried point.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Accuracy is in expectation over algorithm and oracle seeds. No almost-sure or high-probability accuracy requirement is imposed.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexFull.lean: spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, product probability law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation uses gradient-dependent curvature growth and a parameter-dependent large-dimension restriction, alongside a public radius bound and expected objective accuracy.
